description: Use when implementing Redis caching, cache invalidation, or distributed locking in Frappe. Prevents stale cache bugs, race conditions from missing locks, and memory bloat from unbounded cache keys. Covers frappe.cache(), @redis_cache decorator, cache.get_value/set_value, cache invalidation patterns, frappe.lock, TTL strategies.
